payload.title: The shared is_excluded_source predicate is a hand list that disagrees with the repository's own definition of non-production source (the service tsconfig excludes), and further private copies of the fact stay outside the pin, so the outbox adapter reads gateway-api test-utils files as production source
evidence: apps/gateway-api/tsconfig.app.json:11 (the build excludes src/test-utils/** for this service)
apps/admin-api-service/tsconfig.build.json:63-66 (every service build excludes __tests__, test-utils, test-helpers and *.e2e-spec.ts)
tools/aria-poc/outbox_adapter.py:123-124 (an apps/<svc>/src/**/*.ts path is in scope unless is_excluded_source says otherwise)
tools/aria-poc/dual_alias_adapter.py:50 (a private ('node_modules/', 'dist/') tuple, a copy of two shared fragments)
tools/aria-poc/poc.py:311-317 (is_test_source_path, a separate predicate with different members)
tools/aria-poc/invariants/test_adapter_scope_narrow.py:350-358 (the no-private-list pin inspects cqrs_adapter and outbox_adapter for the exact six literals only)
payload.rule_violated: Single owner per concept (CLAUDE.md single-centre rule) and the B18 root cause itself: one definition of non-production source, pinned against the other definitions that exist.
payload.notes: Executed on the revision's adapter_scope.py: is_excluded_source is False for apps/gateway-api/src/test-utils/index.ts, apps/gateway-api/src/test-utils/mock-types.ts, a z.e2e-spec.ts and a test-helpers/h.ts path, although the build config excludes all of them. The outbox adapter therefore reads the two tracked gateway-api test-utils files as production source (0 findings today); a mock publisher or e2e helper placed under apps/*/src would be judged as domain code for domain_event_published_outside_outbox. Repository e2e specs live under apps/<svc>/test, outside the scope, which is why none is read today. Close condition: Add `.e2e-spec.ts`, `/test-utils/` and `/test-helpers/` to adapter_scope, make dual_alias_adapter use the predicate, and add a test that every test-source exclusion listed in the service tsconfig.build.json files is excluded by is_excluded_source. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 2b). Verified at head b2259fe03f of open pull request #2151; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
